method: Compile and execute the lesson’s offline in-memory FileService fixture; exercise the ten security boundaries; run the optional Anthropic loop against a fake client for visible and empty end_turn, nonterminal stop reasons, absent/duplicate tool_use IDs with no side effects, and unknown-tool tool_result pairing; assert lesson caveats and linked resource IDs.

observations.model: offline fixture and fake Anthropic client

limitations: The 2026-10-08 model outputs and three-sample denominators are not independently reproducible because raw requests, responses and scorer are missing; this review does not validate their reported values or estimate model behavior.

No real provider, filesystem, authorization service, database, distributed grant store, production approval workflow or multi-process race was exercised. The teaching fixture is process-local and in-memory.

The fake Anthropic client validates local stop-reason routing, empty-turn handling, pre-dispatch tool_use ID checks and tool_result pairing only; it does not establish provider conformance or safety of external side effects.
Documentation review covers provider-specific strict schema behavior and authorization boundaries; it does not prove every endpoint supports the same JSON Schema subset.
